display.purpose: Serif headlines and main lesson headings.

body.purpose: Clean, highly readable text inside exercise blocks and dialogs.

shadows.name: card-lift-shadow
shadows.purpose: Elevation effect on interactive card hovers.

components.name: Tactile 3D Button
components.description: Tactile 3D press button used for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-duo-cta { background: #1648a8; border-radius: 12px; border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; outline-offset: 4px; display: inline-block; } .ds-duo-cta > div { display: block; padding: 12px 32px; border-radius: 12px; background: #1d5ed4; color: white; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: transform 120ms ease; } .ds-duo-cta:hover > div { transform: translateY(-6px); } .ds-duo-cta:active > div { transform: translateY(0px); }

components.name: Vocabulary Chip
components.description: Interactive vocabulary word pill with active 3D compression response.
components.css: .ds-duo-chip { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fef3c7; border: 1px solid #e7e5e0; border-bottom: 3px solid #d97706; color: #d97706; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, border-bottom-width 120ms ease; } .ds-duo-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-duo-chip:active { transform: translateY(2px); border-bottom-width: 1px; }

components.name: Interactive Raised Card
components.description: Dashboard card designed to lift dynamically on hover.
components.css: .ds-card-lift { padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: white; border: 1px solid #e7e5e0; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-lift h3 { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; color: #1c1917; font-size: 20px; } .ds-card-lift p { margin: 0; color: #57534e; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-lift:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); }

narrative.overview: Verbalize is a premium, interactive language-learning sanctuary. It rejects the cold, flat, gray aesthetics of generic software tools in favor of a warm, rich, physical workspace. Every interactive element possesses visual weight and dimensional presence, rewarding actions with immediate physical feedback, micro-animations, and high-fidelity sonic reinforcement.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Dimensions: Buttons and chips feel physical, using subtle bottom borders (3D press effects) and scale transitions.
Dynamic Physics: Orchestrated springs and micro-shakes bring correct and incorrect answers to life.
Editorial Contrast: Sophisticated serif display headers paired with clean, accessible sans-serif body typography.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Accents (Amber and Purple) must never dominate more than 15% of a given screen. They are reserved strictly for isolating vocabulary and verb types to optimize visual scanning during active exercises.

rules.name: The Sentence Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Exercise texts must use a line-height of exactly 1.7 (.lesson-text) to allow pronunciation markers and translate hints to sit cleanly between lines without clipping.

rules.name: The Tactile Spring Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat or shallow at rest with a 1px border. Shadows appear only on hover or focus to signify lift. Active clicks must shift elements downwards by 2px to 4px to simulate physical buttons.

dos: Do use strict WCAG AA contrast (≥4.5:1) for all translation text. Ensure muted bridge text remains highly legible.
Do pair .animate-correct with positive auditory feedback and .animate-shake with incorrect answers to give multisensory reassurance.
Do limit display serif typography strictly to headings (h1 through h3) and keep DM Sans for all instructions.
donts: Don't use generic, cold gray borders. Always use warm clay borders (#e7e5e0).
Don't use flat, non-animated state changes on exercise choices. Active buttons must bounce or translate to reward interaction.
Don't use side-stripe borders or neon text gradients. Design accents must rely purely on clean background shapes and text sizing.
